name: Circuit breaker with undervoltage release
summary: A breaker undervoltage release changes the breaker operating condition when its control voltage falls below the specified range.
description: A breaker undervoltage release changes the breaker operating condition when its control voltage falls below the specified range. Schematics show the release supply and any associated permissive or trip circuits.
readingNotes: Follow the control supply separately from the breaker main poles.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: An undervoltage release responds to its own supply; a voltage protection relay can measure another circuit and issue a separate trip.
